name: SB1-sandbox-lifecycle
control: sandbox lifecycle: launch, vestibule, shelf, inspect, disposition, teardown, residue probe (stub VM)
note: P0.4 flow. Fresh jail id per task. The VM is a stub host (fake pids, real scratch jail folders). Vestibule, shelf, stage, verdict validate, decide_disposition, decision chain and assert_host_vmm_hygiene are the real crates. hash_lie: the guest claims clear for bytes other than the staged ones. leak_probe: the stub leaves its jail folder and pid behind, and the hygiene check must catch it.
